description: This vulnerability pattern occurs when distributed consensus protocols fail to enforce monotonic progression of safety-critical state markers. In blockchain and BFT systems, certain markers (safe blocks, finalized blocks, committed checkpoints) represent irreversibility guarantees - once a block/state reaches this status, it should never be reversed or moved backward.
trigger_condition: Byzantine consensus client sends state update messages that move safety markers (safe block, finalized block, checkpoint) backward in the protocol's progression order (height, epoch, slot number)
